sources.rationale: Retain fresh publish authorization and a single metadata owner. Existing P3.4 publication path already owns this; do not add another acceptance path.
Adapt local transaction rollback, immutable replay and source guards to tenant-qualified PostgreSQL delivery/inbox transactions; donor has no approved outbox lease/fence/inbox implementation.
Adapt real process death before/after commit, restart, conflicting immutable identity and tenant isolation tests.

Preserve committed state despite notification failure and identify interrupted staged work; replace file ownership with committed PostgreSQL leases and fences. Progress and transport success cannot publish.
Preserve unknown/unavailable and incomplete inventory semantics. Expose operational delivery lag/errors without treating them as authority or copying document inventory.
Retain prior immutable published identities across failed rebuilds. Reject filesystem readiness/latest fallback and short digest identity; invalidation events never reactivate a generation.
Adapt interrupted candidate, identity retention, no publication from progress, and notification failure scenarios to PostgreSQL metadata/outbox and executable fixtures.

reuseScope: Algorithm and regression adaptation only; no donor runtime dependency, source code copying, file-journal owner or exactly-once external I/O claim.

licenses.agentools: Private source reuse authority from the execution-input; no donor implementation copied.
licenses.deeptutor: Apache-2.0; existing retained license/notices in docs/architecture/third-party/DeepTutor-LICENSE.txt and DeepTutor-THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

newCodeRationale: The approved existing PdoOutbox append and publication/lifecycle transactions remain the owners. Donors lack tenant-qualified lease capability hashes, conditional delivery fences, atomic inbox invalidation, sequence conflict blocking and the closed event-1.0 protocol. Small vendor-free ports/application and PostgreSQL implementations fill those gaps without changing the approved wire schema.
sourceGaps: No plan read API is exposed; required normative reads were supplied inline. Optional full reuse-policy context was not loaded.
Plan receipt mirror is not written because result_contract.plan_mutation is forbidden; the tracked tests/events/outbox/evidence/P3.5-reuse.json is the executor handoff.

No external transport or optional remote authoritative reader is implemented or qualified. PostgreSQL integration tests exercise real metadata, delivery and inbox; in-process transport doubles model timeout/poison behavior.
Invalidation projections are always stale and cannot grant access; resolving a gap does not assert a rebuilt projection. Unknown authoritative aggregates retain their gap.
For pre-existing outbox rows, operational enqueue-age starts at migration application; historical commit timestamps were not stored.

validation.donorHashes: All seven shortlisted local SHA-256 hashes matched the pinned execution-input; relevant algorithm/test sections inspected before implementation.
